t141: All prices are in US dollars (USD). Each license runs for one year and does not renew automatically: nothing is charged again unless you choose to renew. Backed by a 7 day refund policy.
t143: No. BugIt runs in any assistant that can run a command: Copilot Chat, the Claude extension in VS Code, or a plain terminal. It can also run standalone with your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.
t145: No. Your tickets, specs and tokens do not pass through our servers. Only license and update data does, and every field is listed in the privacy notice.
t146: What do I need to run it?
t147: An AI assistant that can run a command, Python 3.10 to 3.14, and the tracker you already use. Windows 11 is fully supported; macOS and Linux are in preview.
t149: Your files and settings stay. Filing needs an active license, and nothing renews unless you buy again.
